VIDEO DETAILS & HIGHLIGHTS:
 📌 How to Build a Notary Network for Your Asset Recovery Business

One of the biggest mistakes I see new investigators make is waiting until they have a signed client before they start looking for a notary.

By then, you're already behind.

In this video, I show you how to build what I call a "Notary Dream Team"—a reliable network of notaries located throughout the cities and counties where you work.

Having trusted notaries in place before you need them can help you:

✅ Close deals faster

✅ Reduce delays and missed opportunities

✅ Create a smoother experience for your clients

✅ Scale your business into multiple markets

✅ Spend less time scrambling for last-minute appointments

Whether you're working in state funds, unclaimed property, surplus funds, or other asset recovery opportunities, having a strong notary network is a critical part of your business infrastructure.

In this video, I'll show you exactly how I find, organize, and manage notaries so they're ready when I need them.
